exposure: cases with malpractice due to pediatrician delay
cases with malpractice due to ophthalmologist error
cohort: 26 cases of retinopathy of prematurity (ROP) evaluated by the 7th Specialization Board of the Council of Forensic Science between 2017 and 2020.
finding: Medical malpractice was found in 61.5% of ROP cases, with delays in diagnosis and follow-up being the most common reasons.
